_comment: Defaults of the DTC sign-in experience. Your own copy lives in the deployment's config\login-experience.json; apply changes with scripts\Set-AuthentikLogin.ps1 -InstallPath <deployment> -Action Apply (no restart needed). Points are fractions of the picture (x from the left edge, y from the top edge, r = tap radius as a fraction of the picture width). Taps must follow the list order. Find coordinates by opening the sign-in page with #dtc-calibrate at the end of the address.
